what: det4 prompt footprint sigma0, drift diffusion Dp and Y RC spread D_rc from SPS run_71 RAW head-on tracks, per-event forward fits (headon_sigma.py + analyse_headon.py, ws_sps 2026-10-27)
model: production RC kernel (wft.model.build_matrix_rc), det4 promoted bench bundle, K 60, 64 samples, dead list dropped, RAW drops censored; per event free (p0,w,t0), then chi2 on a (sigma0, Dp[, D_rc]) grid at fixed (p0,w), t0 +-5 ns; summed over 1200 clean events per view per field
selection: leading strip within +-1 of the window centre, 9 strips, window max 250-3200 ADC, no flagged channel (results/health.json) within +-3
amplitude_dependence: none: sigma0 in amplitude terciles flat to +-0.03 mm at every field (X falls slightly with charge); per-event best sigma0 p16-p84 0.19-0.41 mm, 8-14 % of events pick >= 0.42 by scatter alone
verdict: sigma0_Y ~0.32-0.34 supported fleet-wide (det4 SPS 0.32 vs det3 per-event 0.343). sigma0_X 0.29 is an UPPER BOUND (X width grows 2x Magboltz with drift time on det4 X only: the unmodelled one-sided X copy / bench X width excess); defensible X range 0.24-0.29. No physical basis for the per-event wide footprint on unsaturated pulses. Saturation untested (the beam never saturates).
zs_effect: ZS emulated 4-5 sigma with zeros CENSORED: sigma0_Y +0.09..+0.14, sigma0_X -0.09..+0.04, D_rc to the grid floor; ZS-censored data cannot measure the footprint
dropped_samples_as_zero: fitting the RAW drops as measured zeros (every earlier wft fit on these caches): sigma0 +0.01, chi2/dof +30 %
transfer: sigma0 = readout (strip box + induction): board property, transfers; Dp is a beam-gas number (wet Ar/CF4/iso + O2) and does NOT transfer to the bench (Ar/iso 95/5); D_rc is a per-chamber construction constant (det4 only)
